title: Run a command on many files at the same time
summary: Hand a long list of files to xargs and let it run several copies of a command at once. Large batch jobs such as checksums or conversions finish sooner on a multi-core computer.

aliases.text: run command on many files in parallel linux
use all cpu cores for batch job
запустить команду на многих файлах параллельно
использовать все ядра для пакетной задачи

steps.explain: Count the CPU cores. A JOBS value up to this number keeps every core busy without overloading the computer.
find sends file names separated by zero bytes. xargs -0 reads them, -n 1 gives each run one file, and -P sets how many runs go at the same time. md5sum prints a checksum for each file.
steps.expect: One line per file: a long hexadecimal checksum, then the file name. Lines can come out in a different order, because copies finish at different times.

placeholders.name: JOBS
placeholders.description: How many copies run at once

warnings: Too many jobs can make the computer slow. For jobs that read a lot from the disk, keep JOBS low.
